content: We need to determine number of aromatic carbon atoms in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the compound. We can get 13C NMR spectra via carbon_nmr_spectra tool, which will give peaks. Aromatic carbons appear in typical range ~110-160 ppm. We could count peaks in that range. But we need to know the sample's compound; maybe the system has a sample loaded. Use carbon_nmr_spectra.
